summary: Commonwealth Edison Company filed an 8-K reporting the issuance of $600M and $825M in first mortgage bonds, Series 139 (4.550%, due 2031) and Series 140 (5.850%, due 2056). Proceeds will redeem $500M of existing Series 120 bonds and for general corporate purposes. The bonds are secured by a first mortgage on utility plant. This is a routine debt financing, not a special situation.
